title: Chreode: A Cell World Model for One-Step Temporal Dynamics and Perturbation Prediction
reviewer_a_notes: The action-conditioned claim is supported by architecture and perturbation transfer, but developmental pretraining uses a null action and no action-removal, shuffle, dose, or causal test. Frozen external validation refers only to the zero-shot Weinreb fate analysis; the time-transition and GEARS tasks involve downstream training.
reviewer_b_notes: Highest claim is action-conditioned because the paper defines a nominal intervention-conditioned transition and perturbation task. However, the action token is null during temporal pretraining and the Norman result replaces a GEARS embedding rather than evaluating a standalone action-conditioned Chreode operator. Multiple elapsed-time targets are one-step queries, not free-running rollout. Cross-dataset results use fine-tuning, so external evidence is adapted rather than frozen. The do(a) notation triggers causal scrutiny, but no effect contrast, identification strategy, overlap analysis, or counterfactual validation is provided. Qualitative dual-use discussion supports safety=1 without a hazard test.

title: Clin-JEPA: A Multi-Phase Co-Training Framework for Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining on EHR Patient Trajectories
reviewer_a_notes: The model consumes observed intervention text and claims proposed-action rollout, but action influence is not isolated. Rollout evidence is strong for latent fidelity, although predictions are not decoded to clinical measurements and all experiments use MIMIC-IV.
reviewer_b_notes: The model genuinely consumes its own predicted latent states in a 48-hour autoregressive rollout, with horizon-resolved L1 drift and collapse diagnostics. Actions are encoded, but their contribution is never isolated by an action-agnostic comparator or perturbation. All evidence is from MIMIC-IV, and downstream utility is an offline risk-probe result rather than clinician or policy evaluation. The paper makes no counterfactual or treatment-effect claim, so causal fields are NA. Public code plus detailed data construction and hyperparameters support reproducibility=2 despite credentialed MIMIC access.

title: Model-based reinforcement learning for ultrasound-driven autonomous microrobots.
reviewer_a_notes: Closed-loop physical control and explicit collision, overshoot, loss-of-view recovery, and flow stress tests support decision and safety evidence at the artificial-platform stage. Dynamics fidelity is indirect because the world model is judged mainly through learning and control rather than held-out transition prediction.
reviewer_b_notes: Planning is supported because latent imagined trajectories train a sequential policy that executes real ultrasound commands in closed-loop image feedback. Direct state-transition fidelity and horizon-resolved imagined-rollout error are not evaluated, so state, dynamics, and rollout remain indirect/limited. Action settings and magnitudes are varied, but there is no action-agnostic comparator. Sim-to-real and unseen-channel results require continued adaptation, not frozen validation. Physical hazard evidence is unusually strong for this corpus: collision, overshoot, flow displacement, tracking loss, cavitation concern, constraints, shutdown, reset, and action-reversal rescue are tested or demonstrated. Public code, data, and checkpoints support reproducibility=2.

title: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
reviewer_a_notes: Despite the world-action label and motion-planning motivation, the model receives no exogenous action or robot command; it passively forecasts future visual states and observed instrument trajectories. The qualitative repository is not a verified implementation of training and evaluation.
reviewer_b_notes: The title and framing claim relevance to surgical motion planning, so coding is against planning. The experiment nevertheless forecasts the recorded expert trajectory as an output and never conditions on, selects, optimizes, or executes a chosen action. It earns direct state/dynamics and free-running rollout evidence because decoded visual states and trajectory errors are reported across five segments of a fully autoregressive 15-step rollout. Decision evidence is only an offline planning proxy. The single benchmark, missing split details, no repeated-run statistics, absent uncertainty, and lack of public training code limit external and reproducibility evidence.
